definitions: A person who observes the stars, especially an astronomer or an astrologer.
A dreamer; one who is impractical or visionary.
Any of various marine fishes of the family Uranoscopidae, which have eyes on the top of the head and often bury themselves in sand.
examples: The stargazers gathered at the observatory.
He was a bit of a stargazer, always lost in thought.
We spotted a stargazer camouflaged on the seabed.
